# Convert Image to Black & White

- Route: `/tools/grayscale-image`
- Kind: `tool`
- Category: `image`
- Slug: `grayscale-image`

## Summary

Turn a colour photo into grayscale, or sepia for a vintage tone, and download it in any format. (Image tools)

## Details

Black and white strips a photo to light, shape and texture, hides colour casts and mixed lighting, and gives a set of photos a consistent look. Media Manipulator converts to grayscale on our servers with ImageMagick using a luminance-weighted conversion, offers sepia and vintage tones, and exports in any image format.
### What it does
- Converts a colour image to grayscale with correct luminance weighting.
- Sepia and vintage alternatives for a warm or aged tone.
- Combine with crop, resize, text and format conversion.
- The monochrome copy can be JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF or GIF.
### How to use it
1. Upload an image: Any common format.
2. Keep grayscale or pick sepia: Filter is preselected.
3. Convert: ImageMagick applies the conversion.
4. Download: Save the result.
### Supported formats
- Input: jpg, png, webp, gif, avif, heic, bmp, tiff
- Output: jpg, png, webp, avif, gif
### Technical details
- Grayscale uses Rec. 709 luminance weights, so greens read brighter than blues as the eye expects.
- Sepia applies a tone after grayscale; vintage adds a slight fade and vignette.
- The output keeps three channels unless you pick a format that stores grayscale natively.
### Use cases
- Portrait: Classic black-and-white headshot.
- Document scan: Grayscale a photographed page.
- Vintage look: Sepia on a family photo.
- Print: Prepare for a black-and-white printer.
### FAQ
Q: Grayscale or desaturate?
A: This is a luminance-weighted grayscale, which looks more natural than simply removing saturation.
Q: Can I get a sepia tone?
A: Yes. Pick sepia or vintage in the filter select.
Q: Can I do this to a video?
A: Yes. Use Adjust video colour and set saturation to -100.
Q: Is the original colour recoverable?
A: No. Keep the original file.
